errors.evidence: The description of the left chart does not mention the black line which, according to the legend, represents "Gebietskörperschaften insgesamt" (total regional authorities) and tracks the total investment value.

errors.text_span: Die rechte Grafik ist eine Linienkarte
errors.evidence: The right graph is not a line chart ("Linienkarte"); it is a stacked bar chart with a line overlay, similar in structure to the left graph.

The description fails to explain the fundamental difference between the left and right charts. The reference description clarifies that the left chart shows gross investment and the right chart shows net investment, which explains the significant difference in values. Without this distinction, the purpose of having two charts is not conveyed.

errors.text_span: während in der rechten Grafik nur eine Linie dargestellt ist
errors.evidence: This statement is false. The right graph also contains stacked bars for "Bund", "Länder", and "Gemeinden", which are completely omitted from the description.

errors.text_span: wobei die Höhe jedes Balkens die Summe der Investitionen aller drei Kategorien für das jeweilige Jahr darstellt
errors.evidence: This phrasing is ambiguous. It should clarify that the total height of the *stack* of bars represents the sum, while the height of each individual colored bar segment represents the investment of that specific category.
